name: Enron (2001)
outcome: Accounting fraud exposed, bankruptcy, 60k jobs lost, Arthur Andersen dissolved
key_lesson: When D2+D3 both collapse, boundary fraud (D1) goes undetected until catastrophic

name: Theranos (2018)
outcome: Technology fraud exposed, criminal conviction, $9B valuation to zero
key_lesson: Absolute power (D7=1) enables information suppression (D3=1) which sustains narrative fraud (D5=1)

name: FTX (2022)
outcome: Customer funds misappropriated, bankruptcy, criminal conviction
key_lesson: Circular coupling (D6=1) between entities hides insolvency; no checks on power (D7=1) enables it

name: WeWork (2019)
outcome: IPO collapsed, valuation crashed from $47B to ~$8B, founder removed
key_lesson: Uniformly mediocre scores (all 2s) indicate systemic dysfunction, not a single point of failure

name: Wirecard (2020)
outcome: €1.9B missing cash fabricated, CEO arrested, auditor failure
key_lesson: Boundary fraud (D1=1) combined with information fabrication (D3=1) can defeat external audits

name: Berkshire Hathaway (2020s)
outcome: Stable succession planned, continued outperformance, trust capital highest in industry
key_lesson: Deliberate decoupling (D6=5) and patient capital (D4=5) create anti-fragile structure

name: Costco (ongoing)
outcome: Consistently high employee retention, customer loyalty, steady growth
key_lesson: Incentive alignment (D2=5) cascades positively through all other dimensions

name: Boeing (2019)
outcome: 737 MAX crashes killed 346, grounding, $20B+ losses, reputation devastated
key_lesson: D2+D3 weakness (schedule incentives overriding safety signals) is the classic engineering disaster pattern

name: Wells Fargo (2016)
outcome: 3.5M fake accounts scandal, $3B+ fines, CEO resignation, lasting brand damage
key_lesson: A single dimension at 1 (D2 incentive inversion) can bring down an otherwise middling system

name: GE Immelt era (2017)
outcome: Market cap dropped from $270B to $80B, dividend cut, conglomerate break-up
key_lesson: Temporal cannibalism (D4=1) eventually destroys the system even when other dimensions are middling

name: TSMC (ongoing)
outcome: Global semiconductor leadership, massive capex cycles paying off, geopolitical importance rising
key_lesson: Patient capital (D4=5) is the foundation; D6=3 (geographic concentration) is the known vulnerability

name: Apple Cook era (2023)
outcome: Sustained profitability, services revenue growth, Vision Pro launch as temporal investment
key_lesson: Uniformly high (4s) scores indicate institutional health but supply chain coupling (D6=3) is monitored risk

name: Microsoft Nadella era (2024)
outcome: Cloud dominance, AI pivot, market cap tripled, culture transformed from Ballmer era
key_lesson: Smooth power transition (D7=4) enabled temporal reorientation (D4=5) that transformed the company

name: Twitter/X post-acquisition (2023)
outcome: Advertiser exodus, user decline, brand damage, valuation cut ~75%
key_lesson: Absolute power concentration (D7=1) accelerated degradation across all other dimensions simultaneously

name: Wikipedia (ongoing)
outcome: Sustained as the world's largest reference work, volunteer model thriving, high trust
key_lesson: Mission-aligned incentives (D2=5) + information quality culture (D3=5) create self-reinforcing virtuous cycle

name: Soviet Union (1989)
outcome: Dissolved in 1991, 15 successor states, command economy abandoned
key_lesson: When D3+D4+D5 all hit 1, the system is running on inertia only — any reform attempt triggers collapse

name: Switzerland (ongoing)
outcome: Continued stability, high GDP per capita, institutional resilience through global crises
key_lesson: Federal architecture (D6=5) + institutionalized power distribution (D7=5) create deep structural resilience

name: Singapore (ongoing)
outcome: Continued prosperity, smooth 4G leadership transition, smart nation initiatives
key_lesson: Exceptional temporal metabolism (D4=5) compensates for information constraints (D3=3) and power concentration (D7=3)

name: Venezuela (2024)
outcome: Continued economic collapse, hyperinflation, mass emigration (7M+), disputed elections
key_lesson: Once D2+D3+D4 all collapse, recovery requires external shock — internal reform mechanisms are broken

name: North Korea (ongoing)
outcome: Regime survival via nuclear deterrence and total control, population impoverished
key_lesson: D7=1 + D3=1 can sustain a system indefinitely if D1 (external boundaries/deterrence) holds

name: Ukraine (2022-2024)
outcome: Survived full-scale invasion, Western alliance support, internal cohesion maintained
key_lesson: Narrative strength (D5=5) can sustain a system through extreme boundary (D1=2) and coupling (D6=2) stress

name: Lebanon (2020-2024)
outcome: Economic collapse, port explosion, currency collapse, no functioning government
key_lesson: When D6+D7 both hit 1, every crisis cascades everywhere and no one has power to stop it

name: US Federal Reserve (ongoing)
outcome: Navigated pandemic response, inflation fight, maintained independence despite political pressure
key_lesson: Institutionalized independence (D7=5) protects information quality (D3) and temporal patience (D4)

name: FAA Boeing oversight (2018)
outcome: Regulatory capture enabled 737 MAX certification failure, 346 deaths

name: NHS UK (2023)
outcome: Post-COVID backlogs, staff burnout, growing wait times, but high public legitimacy maintained

name: Danish wind energy market (ongoing)

name: US subprime market (2007)

name: Patagonia (ongoing)

name: SpaceX (ongoing)

name: OpenAI (2023-2024)

name: Koch Industries (ongoing)
